verdict.statement: Vaporize v0.0.1 should remain in release prep until substrate-owned Apple project-generation truth moves from XcodeGen project.yml surfaces to a Pkl-backed owned path, with any remaining XcodeGen surfaces explicitly quarantined as compatibility or historical evidence. The approved Swift YAML read bridge is now landed as migration intake, not as release-unblocking generation.
verdict.why: The tree has broad project.yml and checked-in pbxproj reliance, direct XcodeGen runner code, and no existing Pkl Apple-project generation model. Releasing Vaporize as an internal essential tool before that migration would teach assistants the wrong project-generation boundary.

recommendedMigrationPlan: Freeze: do not add new substrate-owned project.yml surfaces unless they are explicitly marked legacy-compatibility.
Read bridge: use Vaporize inspect-project-yml as the quarantined Swift intake surface for legacy project.yml parity evidence.
Model: author an AppleProjectSpec Pkl module for the common project.yml shape: options, settings, packages, targets, sources, info, scripts, schemes, and configurations.

Shadow parity: for one wrkstrm-core app, express the existing project.yml as Pkl and prove that the rendered transitional YAML is semantically equivalent. This is a parity harness only, not the final release path.
Owned generator: add a Swift-owned generator path that consumes Pkl-evaluated project data and writes the .xcodeproj world-state with receipts.
Vaporize integration: add a Vaporize generation mode that owns Pkl evaluation, project world-state generation, receipt emission, and app build/install composition.
Cutover: migrate wrkstrm-core apps first, then generator/scaffold surfaces, then wrkstrm-app and wrkstrm-components fleet surfaces.
Quarantine: tag any remaining XcodeGen path as historical, external, or compatibility-only; make release gates fail on unclassified substrate-owned XcodeGen use.
doNotDo: Do not mark XcodeGen integration as the forward canonical Vaporize release path.
Do not mechanically rename project.yml to a Pkl file without a typed model and generation receipt.
Do not let app runners invoke xcodegen directly after Vaporize owns the lane.
Do not claim v0.0.1 is internally releasable while Pkl project-generation evidence is missing.
nextConcreteWork: Create AppleProjectSpec.pkl and one Concourse Pkl port as the first parity specimen.
Add a typed comparison receipt between inspect-project-yml output and Pkl-evaluated project data before project generation.
Author a PklProjectGenerationReceipt model for the Pkl-to-world-state step.
Add a Vaporize bead for release-gate enforcement that scans for unclassified substrate-owned XcodeGen invocations.
Update versioned-macos-app-install workflow tool refs from xcodegen to Vaporize/Pkl generation once the owned mode exists.
